modern safety protocols, these environments are just naturally harsh. Miners have to work 
in tight, unstable tunnels with poor ventilation and barely any light. In conditions l ike 
that, you really can't afford a single mistake. The biggest issue is response time—the delay 
between an accident happening underground and the surface control room actually 
finding out is usually what determines if a worker survives..

miner’s localized environment and surface -level safety administration. While modern

sudden environmental and physical hazards because traditional  safety equipment is
